issue.title: Task-bead backlog, epic 1: fix the five most important open task beads
issue.description: The five most important open task beads in the sase project are resolved on master and closed with recorded evidence: sase-1of (Full CI visual-test red), sase-14r (the shard-timings table is about to turn Master Gate red), sase-1nw (the stuck bead read model burns CPU and disk on athena), sase-yo (closed-as-done beads strand unlanded work), and sase-1dp (agent transcripts reach the public sidecar unscanned). payload.entry: Planning evidence: no previous implementation notes were present. The current run, prompt, and pending-object publishers lack secret-scan guards and GH013 recovery; generic retired/quarantined retries can revive requests, and rejected object commits can survive ahead of upstream. Prepared a five-phase child epic (core protection/state, transcript enforcement, prompt/object enforcement, rejection recovery, private audit) with parent_bead=sase-1oh.5. Validation passed with --explain and again without it, both with zero warnings. No product files changed and this phase remains open for the approved implementation and child lander. epic-symbols currently reports no entries.
